positiveVariances: Soy sauce: +£32 – Chefs are not using enough sauce for the squid.
Dill: +£21 – Not enough dill added to the chicken salad and dill aioli.
Xigalo cheese: +£19 – Chefs are adding less cheese mix than the recipe requires.

actionPlan: Monitor dish portions closely to ensure they are correct and consistent with recipes.
Reinforce recipe adherence with the team, particularly regarding dips, sauces, garnishes, and cheese portions.
Conduct regular portion checks during service to identify and correct inconsistencies immediately.
Ensure all waste is recorded accurately and promptly.
Focus on reducing over-portioning, food waste and cooking errors to prevent future variances and maintain GP performance.

btfm.story: Canadian couple came in for a pre-theatre dinner on a whim and sat at the bar on a busy midweek PM service. Served by Vi & Marshall, they had such a great experience they returned two more nights; we gifted them a round of drinks on the house and they left a glowing review.

narrative.weeklyOverview: Sales hit £62,290 vs £53,744 budget (+14.73%) — and £61,977 vs £57,000 forecast (+£4,977 / +8.7%), driven by £25.81 SPG, solid drinks attach (1.25), and strong Marcus Choice/Festive mix (22.5%). Hyde Park Winter Wonderland opening on Thu 19 Nov boosted footfall from Thu–Sun, while the Piccadilly/District line tube strike (Fri 20 – Sat 21 Nov) caused some booking cancellations that were more than offset by walk-ins stuck around Victoria (Fri +18.6% and Sat +16.4% vs forecast). Kitchen speeds held under 10 mins across the week, though Sat PM (£13,965) needed one more strong chef.
narrative.operationalFocus: Aggressive Fork & Manual phone peak booking pacing created bottlenecks during weekend brunch and Fri/Sat dinner, requiring targeted goodwill discounts for short waits. Tighten kitchen portion adherence (dips, sauces, garnishes, cheese) and ensure prompt waste logging (lamb, Greek sausage, bar dairy/purees).
narrative.teamMaintenanceTraining: Service hours ran +66.8h over scheduled (BOH +37.2h, FOH +17.4h, Bar +12.2h) alongside 150.2h non-service/training hours (HC Luis 50.2h, SC Serdal 48h, Benvenuto notice 16h, Stint Willow 6h, Jago bar dev 6h, Jamal 3h), driving elevated labour % (40.72%). Jamal failed probation and has left the business. Eloise was off following a head injury and Ruth (AGM) was sick on Sun 22 Nov; combined with Amelia away, weekend floor cover was tight with management stepping in. New FOH starter Kai joins w/c 23 Nov.

highlights: 26x 5★ reviews praising exceptional customer service, food & atmosphere.
Shout-outs for Freddie, Marshall & Vi (including a returning Canadian couple served by Vi & Marshall across three nights).
Negative themes: Busy, loud weekend atmosphere; 2x 3★ (no comment, Sat & Sun); 1x 2★ ('food is not great', Sat).
guestSentiment.actions: Celebrate & recognise Freddie, Marshall, and Vi in briefings; refine weekend booking pacing and floor staffing to manage peak noise and wait times.

focusBoard.description: Bring service hours back in line with schedule (+66.8h overrun in W34) as HC Luis and SC Serdal transition out of initial training hours into target 38% labour.
